move: cursor hovers badges: colour floods, ring pulses, sparks; locked one shakes
how: Header and four hexagonal badges rise in with expo.out stagger. A cursor moves badge to badge (power3.inOut) and at 17%, 40% and 63% each one lights: hex scales 1.1 and rotates 8deg with back.out(2.5) then settles elastic, a gradient layer fades in, a white ring scales .8 to 1.35 and fades, a diagonal sheen sweeps via backgroundPosition, an Unlocked tag pops with back.out(2), and eight sparks fly out radially 90px (power3.out) and vanish. At 85% the cursor nudges the fourth badge which shakes x -6 six times and flashes a Locked tag; everything fades at 95%.
adapt: Rename badges, subtitles and gradients, change the icon SVGs, and choose which ones are locked; keep the light-up sequence timings and the 8-spark burst.
port: mount(el, shot) builds badges from shot.badges and appends sparks; animate returns the timeline with light(i, k*0.23D). Cursor coordinates are stage-absolute (640 + offset), so compute from the size of el; className tweens and immediateRender:false fromTo calls port as is.
caveats: fromTo tweens use immediateRender:false so the rings/sheen stay hidden until their beat
